start.name: Abu Hummus (gas collection unit)
start.coord_basis: OSM place node 769122369 for Abu Hummus town (wikidata Q4165804). World Bank RP1184 resettlement-plan document (the sheet's own Length [ref]) states this line 'starts from the outlet of a gas collection unit at Abo Homos' -- i.e. a specific facility at/near Abu Hummus, not just the town in general -- but gives no coordinates for the unit itself, so anchored to the town center (reduced accuracy).

end.name: Nubaria power station (Nubaria Combined Cycle Power Plant)
end.coord_basis: OSM landuse=industrial way 218972673, named 'محطة كهرباء النوبارية المركبة' (Nubaria Combined Cycle Power Station), Beheira governorate. Matches the World Bank RAP's stated terminus 'the Nubaria power station' by name and administrative area, and is corroborated by a second, independent source (power-plant profile sites returned via web search: mindat.org 'Nubaria Power Station, Beheira Governorate, Egypt' and industryabout.com 'Nubaria III Gas Power Plant' -- both direct-fetch attempts to these two pages 403'd/DNS-failed from this environment, so I am relying on the search-result titles/snippets as the second corroboration, not full page content).

prior_passes.notes: High-confidence resolution. This is the best-documented PID in the group: the World Bank resettlement-plan PDF gives a detailed, named, turn-by-turn corridor description matching both endpoints (Abu Hummus collection unit -> Nubaria power station) and the exact stated length/diameter (65 km / 32in). The Nubaria power station identity is further corroborated by an OSM industrial-landuse tag naming it explicitly as the Nubaria Combined Cycle Power Station, plus web-search snippets from two independent power-plant databases (mindat.org, industryabout.com) confirming a 'Nubaria Power Station'/'Nubaria III Gas Power Plant' in Beheira governorate at that general location (I could not fetch either page's full content directly to pull their own coordinates -- both blocked/DNS-failed from this environment -- so this counts as secondary, not GPS-level, corroboration). Endpoint anchors are at town/facility-polygon level, not the precise pipeline tie-in point, since the RAP text does not give coordinates. Straight-line ratio (1.16x) matches the documented winding corridor well; not flagged as implausible.

staged_now.researcher_notes: ENTSOG rejected: end snap 14.1 km — the network path stops short of the Nubaria plant, outside ENTSOG's p90 Egypt error (13 km). Entire line is buried, with 8 valve rooms along the route.
